title: How he got the nickname Foots
summary: Thomas says small shoes caused foot trouble, and Cab's 'Play it, Foots!' stuck; he bought a tenor.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: And that's how my nickname come up. I already had the nickname by the time Cab got there. See, when I first joined the band, I had a little trouble...
How did the nickname come up, Foots?

Well, I had a little trouble with my foot. I had athletic feet. I was buying shoes too small for me and didn't know it. Because them salesmen in New York, man, was selling me shoes... If they was too small, they'd give you a little larger size, but they wouldn't bother(?) me to last. Because I had a very narrow foot in my early days, because I only weighed about 150 pounds when I got in the band.

So every time I'd play a solo, Cab would get on the microphone and say, 'Play it, Foots! Play it, Foots!' And I'd be doing the best I could. I played the Jazz they was playing in them days, but I wasn't as good as a Ben Webster or some of the other guys that joined the band later

You can't, right. So the band went on and got better and better, and I went and bought me a tenor. Then we came out and started playing in theatres, because we got popular by being on the air. And that next... See,
